title: Critical nonpercolation on locally finite quasi-transitive graphs below one
exact_target: For every infinite connected locally finite undirected quasi-transitive graph whose independent bond critical probability $p_c$ is less than one, does independent bond percolation at $p_c$ have no infinite open cluster almost surely?
